Gephi is like Photoshop for Networks

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

At least, that’s how the sales pitch goes. I don’t use Photoshop much, so I have no idea if it has the same kind of beautiful data transformation features as Gephi.  One of the newest layouts is a simple radial diagram, that can be used to display the members of your network communities in a most attractive manner.
